name: ConnectIND
audience: Indiana founders at any stage
summary: Statewide directory of founder organizations, programs, events, and ecosystem navigators, searchable by county and need.
next_step: Choose your county and the support you need, or ask an ecosystem navigator for an introduction.

name: Indiana Small Business Development Center
audience: Indiana entrepreneurs and small businesses
summary: No-cost, confidential advising and training on starting, financing, and growing a business through regional offices.
next_step: Find your regional office and book an advising session.

name: Indiana FAST SBIR/STTR support
audience: Indiana research and technology startups pursuing federal SBIR/STTR awards
summary: IEDC and Applied Research Institute support for federal grant proposals, including specialist advising, training, and state matching grants for awardees.
next_step: Review FAST support and request proposal advising before the federal solicitation deadline.

name: Indiana Technical Assistance Program (INTAP)
audience: Indiana-based for-profit small businesses that are Indiana SBDC clients
summary: Annual program providing up to $15,000 in qualified Indiana vendor services for growth projects; funds go to the vendor.
next_step: Become an SBDC client, outline a growth project, and watch the program page for the next application cycle.

name: Indiana Innovation Voucher
audience: High-potential Indiana startups and small businesses developing products or services with a research partner
summary: Funding for eligible research and product-development work with an Indiana nonprofit research or academic institution.
next_step: Define a project and scope with a research partner, then review the current voucher application guidance.

name: Manufacturing Readiness Grants
audience: Indiana manufacturers investing in smart manufacturing equipment and processes
summary: Conexus and IEDC grants that help manufacturers make technology-enabled capital investments in Indiana operations.
next_step: Read the current fact sheet and application materials before planning a smart-manufacturing investment.

name: Indiana IN-STEP export grant
audience: Indiana small businesses operating at least one year and pursuing an international market
summary: Reimburses approved international trade activities, subject to current program caps and eligibility rules.
next_step: Review the current eligible activities and submit a scope and budget before incurring expenses.

name: Indiana Capital Access Program
audience: Indiana small businesses seeking lender financing
summary: State credit enhancement that lets participating lenders consider small-business loans that may not meet conventional lending requirements.
next_step: Review eligibility and ask a participating lender whether a loan can use CAP.

name: Indiana APEX Accelerator
audience: Established Indiana businesses selling to government or military customers
summary: No-cost, confidential procurement counseling, workshops, and training for government contracting.
next_step: Find your regional APEX counselor and request assistance with procurement readiness.

name: gBETA Indiana
audience: Early-stage Indiana startups
summary: Free seven-week accelerator with coaching, mentors, investor pitches, and post-program support; selects up to five companies per cohort.
next_step: Review the Indiana cohort and apply or book the listed office hours.

name: 16 Tech Ignition
audience: Indiana collegiate founders, including Purdue students
summary: Eight-week hybrid program for student founders to validate ideas, meet mentors and investors, and connect to Indiana's startup network.
next_step: Check the next cohort and register interest on the Ignition page.

name: 16 Tech Momentum
audience: Early-stage founders, small-business owners, and side-hustlers
summary: Free monthly founder and expert speaker series at 16 Tech, with lunch, networking, and a day of coworking.
next_step: Reserve a spot for the next Momentum session.

name: Machyne Makerspace at 16 Tech
audience: Indiana hardware founders, makers, and product teams
summary: Indianapolis makerspace with fabrication tools and workshops inside the 16 Tech innovation district.
next_step: Review access options and book a tour before building a physical prototype.

name: Indiana Founders Network
audience: Current founders of scaling tech or tech-enabled businesses in Indiana
summary: TechPoint-supported peer network connecting Indiana founders with other founders and venture support.
next_step: Review member criteria and request to join the network.

name: The Mill at Amplify Bloomington
audience: Founders, creatives, remote workers, and small teams
summary: Bloomington coworking and event space that brings together founders and small teams in the Trades District.
next_step: Review day passes or memberships and book a tour.

name: Crossroads Connections
audience: Indiana founders with an idea or early-stage startup
summary: Amplify Bloomington founder program with curated pitch opportunities and introductions to investors, customers, partners, and advisors.
next_step: Review the current selection process and apply to pitch.

name: Startup Summer
audience: Student founders building in the Bloomington region
summary: Summer cohort for emerging student entrepreneurs to turn early concepts into ventures with mentorship, focused work time, and a demo day.
next_step: Check the next Startup Summer cohort and application criteria.

name: 90 Days to Scale
audience: Founders with active businesses and traction goals
summary: Operator-led 90-day execution cycles focused on product delivery, customers, revenue, and peer accountability.
next_step: Read participation details and contact Amplify Bloomington about the next cycle.

name: AMP Monthly
audience: Bloomington-area founders, investors, and startup-curious builders
summary: Recurring Bloomington meetup for founders and investors, pairing a short program with time to meet peers.
next_step: Check the next AMP Monthly event and attend.

name: AgriNovus Velocity
audience: Students, startups, and companies solving Indiana agbioscience problems
summary: Agbioscience accelerator around food as health, bioinnovation, and farmer-focused innovation, with mentorship and track prizes.
next_step: Review current challenge tracks and register for the next application cycle.

name: Northeast Indiana Innovation Community
audience: Northeast Indiana founders, students, innovators, and companies
summary: Fort Wayne network offering coaching, workshops, coworking, and introductions for people launching ventures.
next_step: Choose the starting-a-venture path or attend a free NIIC event.

name: TiE Indianapolis
audience: Early-stage Indiana founders and aspiring entrepreneurs
summary: Local chapter of the global TiE entrepreneur network, offering events, mentors, and founder connections.
next_step: Review associate membership and attend a chapter event.

name: The Startup Ladies
audience: Women founders, investors, and startup allies
summary: Indianapolis-based network for founder education, investor readiness, introductions, and funding opportunities for women-led startups.
next_step: Review membership, programs, and the current investor-readiness accelerator.
